Complete the 3-hour desiccant replacement and dew-point verification on C-2, confirming -40°C or better before campaign release, and upload the lab result to the campaign quality record.

Update the plant shutdown plan and customer scheduling portal to reflect the Sunday 08:00 campaign start, since C-2 compliance and desiccant work cannot all be completed and verified in time for Saturday 06:00.
